profile.name: 赛默飞 FIB-SEM 双束显微镜
profile.description: 用于控制赛默飞双束聚焦离子束-扫描电子显微镜的仪器接口，可执行电子/离子束成像、自动对焦与对比度调整、束流偏转、样品台与纳米操纵杆运动、离子束铣削、GIS 气体注入以及溅射/沉积相关操作，适用于样品表征、截面加工与显微操纵实验。
profile.description_en: An instrument interface for a Thermo Fisher focused ion beam scanning electron microscope (FIB-SEM). It supports electron/ion beam imaging, autofocus and autocontrast, beam shift, stage and nanomanipulator motion, ion-beam milling, GIS gas injection, and sputter/deposition-related operations for sample characterization, cross-section preparation, and micromanipulation workflows.
